# HCLTech DX Component Library v1


Three production-ready Pega Constellation DX components - in-case Word document editing, speech-to-text dictation and a modern toggle switch - configurable in App Studio with no custom code.


- [Contact Seller](https://community.pega.com/form/marketplace-lead-form?source_page=HCLTech%20DX%20Component%20Library%20v1&lead_email=delhibatchab@hcltech.com&nid=2471311)


By using or submitting listings via the Pega Marketplace, you agree to our[Terms of Use](https://community.pega.com/knowledgebase/articles/pega-marketplace-terms-use) .


### Overview


HCLTech DX Component Library v1 is a curated set of three reusable DX components for Pega Constellation, built by HCLTech's Pega practice inheriting platform theming, accessibility and localization out of the box. The library includes the Word Document Editor (open, edit and save .docx case attachments directly on the Pega screen, with a rich-text toolbar and replace-or-keep-both save options), Speech to Text (a text area with live voice dictation whose transcript is committed to the property exactly as if typed) and the Boolean Toggle Switch (a modern, accessible one-click control with configurable Yes/No or True/False read-only display). Every component behaves like a standard Pega field - data binding, validation, visibility conditions and test IDs included - and is configured entirely in App Studio. Install by publishing from source with the DX Component Builder CLI or by importing the packaged product ZIP, and go live in days.


### Key Features


- Edit Word (.docx) case attachments without leaving Pega
- Speech to text with live, as-you-speak transcription
- Modern toggle switch with instant one-click commit
